title: Human Cognitive Attention, Intervention Friction, Outcome Quality & Total-Cost Telemetry Baseline
acceptance_criteria: KAD_OUTCOME_COST_TELEMETRY_V1 schema implemented with typed separation of outcome, quality, human, execution, context, economic, compute, maintenance, and provenance dimensions
Epistemic origin classes explicit (DIRECTLY_OBSERVED, DERIVED_DETERMINISTIC, HUMAN_REPORTED, ESTIMATED, RECONSTRUCTED, UNKNOWN) with UNKNOWN != ZERO strictly enforced
Human intervention taxonomy implemented distinguishing strategic design / research interpretation from corrective friction and babysitting
Quality and escaped defect metrics preserved (escaped_regressions, acceptance_reversals, rollbacks, post_acceptance_defects)
Provider-neutral workload semantics preserved (model/vendor only in run metadata, not required in workload contract)
Local-first storage verified with zero raw-secret capture and SHA-256 record integrity hashing
Telemetry does not own lifecycle state (passively observes workctl/intent/execution evidence without competing authority)
Lightweight complexity telemetry and observer overhead accounting implemented
Goodhart and metric-gaming protections verified via comprehensive semantic TDD suite (T01-T20)
Historical reconstruction from accepted WP receipts classified honestly as RECONSTRUCTED without fabricating unknown metrics
Prospective baseline protocol and initial baseline report generated distinguishing observations, reconstructions, and missing data
Zero automatic policy-feedback control loops implemented (measurement before optimization invariant preserved)
Full repository test suite, doctors, and linters pass cleanly with independent review verification
description: Human cognitive attention, intervention friction, outcome quality, and total-cost telemetry baseline subsystem establishing KAD_OUTCOME_COST_TELEMETRY_V1, observation origin tracking, Goodhart protections, historical reconstruction, and prospective baseline reporting.
